projectDescription: A browser data processing tool to perform science operations/measurements on Astronomy FITS (Flexible Image Transport System) files. The goal was to unlock research grade astronomy for students/compute-restricted users through a browser.

Experimental social media project that features CRUD Todos that are also shareable to other users. Privacy of todos was a high priority which involved building out a security middleware layer as well as leveraging Nest.js permissions. The goal was to try out modern JS frameworks and state/type libraries.
Proof of concept that fetches United States weather & airport runway api data and then recommends the best takeoff and landing strips for headwinds.

A Euclidian clustering Algorithm that accepts a list of tuples as arguments and then represents the points in a 2D space. The Algorithm groups the points using Euclidian distance and assigns the best fit centroid to each group.
A social networking site for plant owners. Complete with account creation and login, profiles, posts, comments, and messages.

This is an NLP program that parses Wikipedia articles using Lucene to then be able to answer a file containing questions about historic events, places, and people. First, the knowledge base is generated, and then you can pass the question text file to receive answers.
